name: Mud cracks 12: xylem
description: Plant cells in long files, like xylem: long dead-straight walls on the simulation grid's own axes, then cross walls at right angles ending in T-junctions, dividing into rectangular cells that keep flat sides, the oldest walls thickest. Starts part dried, just before the first walls. Paint district above a half for patches on the diagonals instead, straight, square, cross_lag, grow, dry, grip or toughness.
